lodash is bumped to 4.17.21 (from 4.17.15), but the tests don't pass: 3 fail in `src/utils/date-utils.spec.js` (DST boundary in America/New_York, local midnight parsing, month-end rollover in local tz).

I haven't shown these failures are pre-existing. The `git stash` run gave identical results, but stash only reverts `package.json` and the lockfile. `node_modules` is normally gitignored, so 4.17.21 was probably still installed during that "baseline" run. A real baseline needs `npm ci` after the stash. Also, the environment reports this directory isn't a git repo, and the stash and pop printed no confirmation, so I can't confirm the stash and pop worked or that your changes are intact. Check `package.json` for `4.17.21`.

The failing tests are all timezone-dependent and don't obviously touch lodash, so the likeliest cause is the machine's TZ or a date-library issue. That is an inference, not something I verified. I also didn't check the registry, so I only know 4.17.21 is the latest 4.x release as of my training.
